hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: LaunchHook charges a fixed 1% fee on ETH/token swaps: for ETH→token buys, it takes the fee from the ETH input via beforeSwap delta; for token→ETH sells, it takes the fee from the ETH output via afterSwap delta. Fees are forwarded to a factory contract (set once by a governor) via depositFees for creator/platform distribution.
